eligible: Only this head and seed's already sealed 256-event batches whose original E60 rollout is naturally closed. Use complete 20 ms transitions within their measured request intervals. Exclude uncovered gaps, discarded tail and all other arms or branches.
recipe: One optimizer update per 16 newly covered event-budget units (128 updates/member at each first pair of nodes, 256 at the last stage). Batch 64, eight states spanning seven physical transitions; original fixed FP32 execution-model loss. Resume the member's optimizer and frozen field normalizer; replay does not become new physical interaction.
private: Rebuild masked input memory from current-foot/target ownership at each state. Current occupied footprints remain protected.
release: One background WM fit per scheduled node, serialized with other W59 trainers. Publish only while the actor barrier is sealed and both current E60 episodes reached natural ends. If a candidate is unavailable, the collectors proceed with the previous version. Private/seed runs have independent weights/optimizers. Diff-fixedWM never starts an online fit.
calibration: An online proposal is pending until the frozen current-version physical action criterion has been checked, preserving the original experimental allocation and recording the evidence identity. A model failing this criterion remains a recorded candidate. A reused historical calibration is labelled reused, and cannot be reported as new independent evidence.
